proposed_from.topic: Identify the nodewise-exact rectangular predictable AIPW quadratic-variation envelope under growing block-adaptive complete randomization; provide two-arm sorting and a fixed-K LP, history-uniform observable plug-in rates over the general moment class and the bounded-residual q_n^{-1/2} subclass, and conservative martingale Wald coverage from the rectangular upper endpoint under explicit predictable-QV stabilization, together with a fixed-fraction no-discount certificate on a nonadaptive fixed-quota subclass. Do not claim that one globally consistent adaptive-history completion attains independently chosen nodewise optimizers.

Gao, Ge, and Qian do not treat predictable adaptive counts, past-fitted AIPW residuals, or history-indexed endpoint processes.","strict_delta":"The core identifies each conditional block variance as a quadratic coupling functional, aggregates the endpoints predictably, proves an explicit \\(C_{\\mathrm{ep}}r_n\\) endpoint bound over a common-parameter uniform class without freezing terminal counts, and derives conservative design-based Wald coverage.","honesty_boundary":"For \\(K>2\\), the finite LP identifies each node's convexified coupling endpoint. The paper does not claim that \\(\\Delta_n^{\\mathrm{node}}(\\boldsymbol\\mu_n)\\) or the stronger root-to-leaf gap \\(\\Delta_n^{\\mathrm{tree}}(\\boldsymbol\\mu_n)\\) vanishes. Open-ended Question 6 separates these obstructions and asks about fixed-fraction undercoverage only along one ex ante completion sequence whose entire induced experiment-analysis array belongs to the full common-parameter class \\(\\mathfrak D\\). Static reductions to Aronow--Green--Lee, Mikhaeil--Green, and Yu--Zhu--Liu are attributed validation checks and carry no novelty claim."}

seed_details.one_line: Predictable multi-marginal transport envelope for block-adaptive AIPW quadratic variation, with history-uniform plug-in estimation and completion-sharp Wald inference.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Identify the exact predictable quadratic-variation envelope in growing block-adaptive complete randomization without conditioning on the terminal allocation path.
anchor_locations_read: LiZhao2026AdaptiveDesignBased, Introduction, Definition 2, Theorem 5, and Section 6 proof reduction
GaoGeQian2025MOT, Introduction, equation (1), Theorem 1, Proposition 2, and Discussion
AronowGreenLee2014SharpVariance, Lemma 1, Proposition 1, Corollary 1, and Discussion
seed_details.referee_objection: This is immediate from Gao, Ge, and Qian block by block once Li and Zhao have supplied a martingale.
seed_details.rebuttal: Static MOT does not establish a predictable random-set identity under outcome-adaptive counts, uniform endpoint estimation over induced histories, or one-sided martingale coverage; the first changed proof step is conditional sampling without replacement at every pre-block history rather than an ordinary empirical-margin argument.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed uses the coupling-native M10 representation and adds the M8 estimation rung and M14 limit theory; it is not a bare identification analogue.

seed_details.one_line: Exact transport envelope for arbitrary history-dependent within-minitrial assignment kernels, including participant-level contextual bandits.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Enlarge complete-block theory to the actual four-arm Newby et al. contextual-bandit assignment law.
anchor_locations_read: NewbyEtAl2025MentalHealth, Introduction, Randomization and Allocation, and Discussion
seed_details.referee_objection: Harshaw, Middleton, and Savje already optimize variance bounds under arbitrary designs.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their admissible quadratic bounds do not recover a marginal-coupling-sharp predictable variance interval, but the destination kernel is materially different because Newby et al. use participant-level probabilities with no arm-count restriction.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The target is not forced into complete-block notation; its distinct assignment covariance tensor is acknowledged.
seed_details.status: dropped after Step 1 because the published protocol has no predictable fixed counts and the first covariance reduction changes

seed_details.one_line: Minimax choice of predictable complete-block arm counts against the transport upper variance endpoint.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Choose next-block counts to minimize the worst compatible AIPW variance while retaining adaptive allocation.
anchor_locations_read: GaoGeQian2025MOT, quadratic MOT formulation and computation section
seed_details.referee_objection: Neyman allocation applied to worst-case residual variances makes this a routine convex program.
seed_details.rebuttal: The transport term couples all arms and changes endogenously with prior-history residual marginals, so a valid certificate would require a dynamic saddle argument rather than armwise Neyman allocation.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The design would require an optimality certificate, not a candidate count rule.

seed_details.one_line: Anytime-valid confidence sequences driven by a predictable transport upper variance process.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Replace fixed-horizon conservative Wald inference by time-uniform inference under adaptive complete blocks.
seed_details.referee_objection: Substituting any predictable variance upper bound into an empirical-Bernstein confidence sequence is automatic.
seed_details.rebuttal: The endpoint is estimated from the same adaptive blocks and is only asymptotically sharp, so finite-time supermartingale domination is not supplied by the fixed-horizon plug-in argument.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is not presented as routine Wald inference; the missing finite-time domination is the kernel.
seed_details.status: dropped after Step 1 because the available endpoint is not a finite-sample predictable upper confidence process

seed_details.one_line: Matrix-valued transport support region for simultaneous multi-arm contrasts under adaptive complete blocks.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Identify the full covariance-matrix region rather than one scalar contrast variance.
seed_details.referee_objection: Taking support functions in contrast directions is a formal restatement of the scalar problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: A single joint coupling must serve all directions, so the matrix region is generally smaller than the intersection of directionwise scalar intervals, but computation and sharpness require a separate common-coupling argument.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The common-coupling restriction prevents cellwise sharpness laundering.

seed_details.one_line: Covariate-conditional transport tightening of adaptive residual variance envelopes.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Use conditional residual marginals to tighten the adaptive transport envelope.
anchor_locations_read: OberReynolds2023OTFunctionals, estimator map and weak-convergence theorem
seed_details.referee_objection: Conditioning static transport bounds on covariates is already explicitly suggested by Gao, Ge, and Qian.
seed_details.rebuttal: The suggestion leaves the adaptive smoothing and history-uniform tuning problem open, but without a sharp rate frontier this is less clean than the unconditional predictable endpoint.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed would need a rate or inference result and is not retained as identification only.
seed_details.status: dropped after Step 1 because the smoothing frontier would dominate the intended block-adaptive kernel

seed_details.one_line: Critical-rank sensitivity analysis for departures from extremal residual coupling.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Parameterize deviations from comonotone or jointly mixable residual ranks and derive the critical departure at which a conclusion changes.
seed_details.referee_objection: A rank-correlation sensitivity parameter merely interpolates between published Frechet endpoints.
seed_details.rebuttal: A nontrivial critical value would require a new constrained-coupling solution, but no natural auditable violation metric emerged from the protocol.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is rejected rather than shipped without a critical scalar grounded in observed primitives.

seed_details.one_line: Transport-completion causal bootstrap for adaptive complete-block experiments.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Resample assignments from an extremal residual completion to refine conservative adaptive inference.
seed_details.referee_objection: Rank-preserving imputation within each block is exactly Yu, Zhu, and Liu with adaptive weights.
seed_details.rebuttal: For more than two arms the extremal coupling need not be rank preserving, and replaying adaptation changes future histories, so the first bootstrap validity step is genuinely different.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The candidate is not called an immediate extension, but it is deferred because second-order validity is a separate project.

seed_details.one_line: Finite-population integrality frontier between deterministic multi-arm completions and the Kantorovich relaxation.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine when a fixed finite-population multi-arm coupling endpoint is attained by unitwise matching rather than only by a fractional transport plan.
anchor_locations_read: GaoGeQian2025MOT, exact identified-set formulation and empirical MOT computation
seed_details.referee_objection: This is a multi-index assignment integrality problem with only indirect econometric content.
seed_details.rebuttal: It is load-bearing for honest finite-population completion sharpness when \(K>2\), but rational replication already suffices for the asymptotic envelope pursued here.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The chosen core states finite LP exactness only for the convexified endpoint and leaves deterministic same-size attainment to the completion question.
seed_details.status: survived as a boundary and open component of the chosen angle
